entity: the 944 for-profit nursing homes whose operating companies were formed 2022 to Sept 2024 (a proxy for a sale), star ratings vs same-state for-profit peers
what_we_add: 944 homes; 0.28 stars below same-state for-profit peers; 52% one- or two-star, 8 points above peers; median home 0.42 stars below
why: No source names this 2022-to-Sept-2024 cohort; the Penn/JAGS study and ASPE say homes that change owners are lower-rated, but about sales through 2022, other homes. Same kind of finding, different homes; no source contradicts the level gap (JAGS -0.09 is a before/after change, a different measure). Boston Globe piece is commentary.
